subjects.description: Cars driving along a busy city street in heavy rain, headlights on, windshield wipers moving.

subjects.relationship: Traffic sharing the street with pedestrians and a cyclist.
subjects.location: In the road lanes, following the same paths as in the original footage.
subjects.orientation: Moving along the road in both directions

subjects.relationship: People moving through the street alongside the traffic.
subjects.location: On the sidewalks and crossings, following the same paths as in the original footage.
subjects.action: Walking quickly with heads down against the rain.

background_setting: The same busy city street as the source video, with the same road, sidewalks, buildings and parked vehicles in the same positions, during a heavy downpour. Rain falls visibly across the whole frame as bright diagonal streaks. The road surface is flooded with shallow puddles, and raindrops splash and ripple in every puddle. Water runs along the curbs and gutters.

lighting.shadows: Almost no shadows because of the heavy cloud cover
lighting.illumination_effect: Headlights and storefront lights reflect as long streaks on the wet road; falling rain is backlit and clearly visible as streaks

aesthetics.composition: Vertical frame of the street from a fixed position, identical to the source video
aesthetics.color_scheme: Desaturated greys and blues with warm reflections from headlights and taillights
aesthetics.patterns: Diagonal rain streaks across the entire frame; expanding ripple rings in puddles

cinematography.framing: Same framing as the source video
cinematography.focus: Sharp focus on the street; falling raindrops visible in the foreground and background

context: Real street footage restyled to heavy rain for autonomous-driving and robotics edge-case testing

actions.description: Heavy rain falls continuously across the whole street while cars and pedestrians move through it along the same paths as in the original footage, tires splashing through puddles.
